test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given Venn diagram carefully and answer the question that follows. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of children who play with a particular toy at a day care.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/370c62ae51b33700754bd73d653dad6abeb8b2ceb542b29ba8bc65c2ae893734.png] 

How many such children are there, who play neither with barbie dolls nor with racing cars?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008ea43bf885da0627908ae9dba7730996d51fc8d6669e0d6bf260b145942d6b.png] 

The shaded region represents the number of children who play neither with barbie dolls nor with racing cars.

So, the number of children who play neither with barbie dolls nor with racing cars = 41

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
